harness: Runs read a saved page from evals/files/pages/, never open Chrome or touch WordPress, and save outputs/seo.json, outputs/audit.json (from audit.py --json) and outputs/response.md. The fixtures are live posts captured on 2026-10-28, so all three carry the site's duplicate <title> tag. chrome-modern-web-guidance-planted.html has six problems added on purpose, and the client name in eval 3's prompt is planted.

evals.name: php-cve-fill
evals.prompt: fill in the Yoast SEO for the PHP CVE post, it has no meta description yet. page: evals/files/pages/php-cve-2026-109618-109619.html
evals.expected_output: A keyphrase the post already uses, an SEO title of 60 characters or fewer ending in ' - Ivan Kristianto', a 120 to 150 character meta description with the keyphrase, an audit run with that keyphrase, and a report that lists post-level suggestions separately from the site's duplicate <title> tag.
expectations: seo.json has focus_keyphrase, seo_title, meta_description and suggestions
Focus keyphrase is 1 to 4 words
Focus keyphrase appears at least 3 times in the article body, or suggestions add it
Focus keyphrase is in the first paragraph, or a suggestion rewrites the intro with it
SEO title is 60 characters or fewer
SEO title has the keyphrase in its first half
SEO title ends with ' - Ivan Kristianto', not the '- ivan' template
Meta description is 120 to 150 characters
Meta description contains the keyphrase
No em or en dashes, exclamation marks or banned words in the title or description
audit.json is an audit.py report run with the chosen keyphrase
leak-check.sh exits 0 on seo.json
Chat reply reports the duplicate <title> tag as a site issue
[judged] The meta description is true to the post and reads in Ivan's first-person voice, not marketing copy
[judged] The keyphrase is what a developer would search to find this post
[judged] Body changes are offered as suggestions with exact wording, not made

evals.name: planted-structure
evals.prompt: audit the on-page SEO of my Chrome Modern Web Guidance post and fill in Yoast. page: evals/files/pages/chrome-modern-web-guidance-planted.html
evals.expected_output: The Yoast fields as in eval 1, plus a report naming each planted problem: two H1s, an image with no alt, an H2 followed by an H4, 'click here' anchor text, a missing og:image and JSON-LD that does not parse. Post problems and site problems are told apart.
